preconditions.description: The number of bus routes is between 1 and 500, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= len(routes[i]) <= 10^5 for all i in range(len(routes))
preconditions.description: Each bus route contains between 1 and 10^5 bus stops, inclusive.
All bus stops are numbered between 0 and 10^6, exclusive.
The starting bus stop S is different from the destination bus stop T.

postconditions.expression: return -1 if S cannot reach T
postconditions.description: The function returns -1 if it is not possible to reach the destination bus stop T starting from bus stop S.

postconditions.expression: return >= 0 if S can reach T
postconditions.description: The function returns the least number of buses required to reach the destination bus stop T from the starting bus stop S, if possible.
